comment: Read automatically by depcheck, which update-npm-deps.ps1 runs at the end of every sweep to report declared
dependencies nothing appears to use. depcheck cannot see a package that is only invoked as a CLI from a script,
named as a string in a config, or pulled in by a compiler option, so each name below is a verified false positive
with the reference that proves it. Because this file exists, anything depcheck still reports fails the sweep -
so a genuinely unused dependency cannot be waved through, and a new entry here needs its reason recorded.
The key is `ignores`, depcheck's CLI-style rc name; `ignoreMatches` is the API-only spelling and is silently
ignored in this file.
@commitlint/cli - .husky/commit-msg runs it as the `commitlint` binary.
@commitlint/config-conventional - extended by name in scripts/commitlint-config.ts.
better-typescript-lib - has no import anywhere by design: it supplies the @typescript/lib-* aliases that
tsconfig.json's `libReplacement: true` resolves (node_modules/@typescript/lib-dom is @better-typescript-lib/dom).
cspell - run as a CLI by scripts/spellcheck.ts.
czg - run as a CLI by scripts/commit.ts.
dprint - run as a CLI by scripts/helpers/format.ts, configured by dprint.json.
globals - imported by scripts/vitest-config.ts (a depcheck parser miss, not an indirect use).
husky - installed by scripts/prepare.ts; the hooks in .husky/ are its output.
jest-config - imported by jest.config.ts and scripts/metadata-global-setup.ts.
linkinator - run as a CLI by scripts/helpers/markdownlint.ts to check links.
markdownlint-cli2 - run as a CLI by scripts/helpers/markdownlint.ts and configured by .markdownlint-cli2.mjs.
nano-staged - .husky/pre-commit runs it; configured by .nano-staged.mjs and scripts/nano-staged-config.ts.
typedoc-plugin-mdn-links - never imported: scripts/docs-gen/helpers/api-doc-link-rendering.ts reads its shipped
data file by path (node_modules/typedoc-plugin-mdn-links/data/web-api.json) to resolve Web API links.
